places.intro_short_en: See the Bird's Nest and Water Cube from the Olympic Green.
places.intro_long_zh: 步行看鸟巢与水立方的外观。比较体育场交错的钢构与游泳中心的泡泡形立面。
places.intro_long_en: See the Bird's Nest and Water Cube from the Olympic Green. Compare the stadium's woven steel exterior with the aquatic center's rounded, bubble-like facade.

places.intro_short_en: Climb the Badaling Great Wall for a view over the pass.
places.intro_long_zh: 沿八达岭城墙登高看关口地形。这里适合第一次近看垛口和敌楼，也能从高处理解关隘的位置。
places.intro_long_en: Climb the Badaling Great Wall for a view over the pass. The parapets and watchtowers make a good first introduction to how the wall guarded a mountain crossing.

places.intro_short_en: A Yanqing stop for a Great Wall and wetlands itinerary.
places.intro_long_zh: 酒店位于延庆东外大街，去八达岭长城或野鸭湖前可从这里出发。品牌位置页也列出延庆站，适合在郊区多住一晚。
places.intro_long_en: Stay in Yanqing to give the Badaling Great Wall and Yeyahu wetlands separate outings. The location guide also names Yanqing railway station for arrival planning.

places.intro_long_en: Pick this riverside address if you plan to spend time along the Liangma River. The hotel sits beside the Genesis Art Gallery and has a 25-meter pool.

带上购票时使用的护照原件，闸机读不出证件时走人工通道。

foreigner_tips_en: PKX means Daxing Airport. When booking a ride, show the airport name in Chinese and your flight number.

terminals.name: T2
terminals.note_zh: 地铁和市域机场线接驳，可步行换乘虹桥火车站。

T2 的市域机场线可坐到浦东机场。
to_city_en: At Terminal 1, take Metro Line 10. At Terminal 2, take Line 2 or 10.
From Terminal 2, the Airport Link Line runs to Pudong International Airport.

places.intro_short_zh: 在上博东馆近看青铜器等馆藏

places.intro_long_zh: 在上博东馆近看青铜器等馆藏。展厅较多，可以先按器物和年代选重点，再安排其他展区。
places.intro_long_en: See bronzes and other collections at Shanghai Museum East. Choose a few collections by material or period to keep a visit to this large museum manageable.

places.intro_long_en: Visit the Shanghai Museum on People's Square. Choose a gallery from the current exhibition list. The museum makes an easy starting point for a walk around the square.

places.intro_long_en: See the Lujiazui street grid from Shanghai Tower. On a clear day, follow the Huangpu River from above and pick out the Bund on its opposite bank.

带上购票时使用的护照原件，闸机读不出证件时走人工通道。
foreigner_tips_en: Show your driver the Chinese station name on your ticket. Saying “Shanghai station” alone can be confusing.
Bring the original passport you used to book. If the gate can't read it, use a staffed lane.

to_city_zh: 可乘地铁11号线、15号线。

带上购票时使用的护照原件，闸机读不出证件时走人工通道。
foreigner_tips_en: Changing stations in Shanghai? Check whether your next ticket says Shanghai West Railway Station.
Bring the original passport you used to book. If the gate can't read it, use a staffed lane.

to_city_zh: 可乘地铁1号线、3号线、4号线。

foreigner_tips_en: A ticket marked 上海 usually means Shanghai Railway Station. Confirm against your booking.
Bring the original passport you used to book. If the gate can't read it, use a staffed lane.

places.intro_long_en: Walk wooded hills at Sheshan National Forest Park. Pick a climb that suits your group and allow time to look at the hilltop architecture.

places.intro_long_en: Connect a warehouse facade with Shanghai's wartime history. Compare the outside of the building with the exhibits explaining the fighting that took place here.

foreign_service.evidence_zh: 上海外滩华尔道夫酒店由国际酒店品牌或集团 Hilton 的官网正式列出并提供预订入口。
